Explain briefly why condensation appears on the outside of a glass of iced water on a humid day. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: The cold glass chills nearby air below its dew point. Air can't hold as much water vapor when cooler, so excess vapor condenses into droplets on the glass's surface.
